changelog: Fixed Bitfunded import failing with SQLSTATE[22003] 'Numeric value out of range' on a low-price, high-quantity coin (PEPEUSDT) -- trades.lot_size widened to DECIMAL(24,8) so a tens-of-billions-unit position no longer overflows the column.

Widened trades.entry_price/exit_price/stop_loss/take_profit from DECIMAL(20,10) to DECIMAL(20,12) as a precision safety margin for micro-cap coin prices (e.g. 0.0000037719) -- a pure widening, no data affected, same precedent as the v3.14.5 price-precision fix.

Trade Log table, the View Trade modal, and the Edit Trade execution summary no longer render a tiny price as a flat '0.00'/'0.0000' -- new fmtTradePrice() (js/app.js) scales the displayed decimal count down with the price's magnitude instead of using a single fixed .toFixed(N).

Audited includes/bitfunded_parser.php and BitfundedImportController.php for any cast/round() that could lose precision on a tiny price or huge quantity -- none found; bf_parse_num() returns an unrounded float all the way to the DB write, and the only round() calls in the import path apply to dollar amounts (net_pnl, risk_amount, r_multiple), never to entry_price/exit_price/lot_size.
release_notes: DB migration: migrations/2026_10_19_0001_widen_lot_size_and_price_precision_for_micro_cap_coins.sql widens trades.lot_size to DECIMAL(24,8) and trades.entry_price/exit_price/stop_loss/take_profit to DECIMAL(20,12). Pure column widening (ALTER ... MODIFY COLUMN, no guard needed, same reasoning as 2026_09_18_0002) -- every existing row's value fits exactly in the wider type, nothing is touched, truncated, or reinterpreted. trades.fees/pnl/net_pnl/risk_amount are deliberately left as-is (account-currency dollar amounts, not implicated by this incident). Back up the trades table before running (mysqldump or phpMyAdmin single-table export -- see the migration file's own header comment and CLAUDE.md Development Rule 6), then confirm the dry-run SELECT against information_schema.COLUMNS before and after. node --check and the duplicate-name scan both pass clean on the two changed JS files (js/app.js, js/trades.js); no PHP changed this release.
